room.label: U.S. adults who have heard of HPV
room.questionWording: Do you think HPV can cause oral cancer? (yes / no / not sure)
room.note: VERIFY: published analyses give 29.5% yes; the no / not-sure split, field dates and the subgroup n are missing. Asked only of people who had heard of HPV.

truthSource.label: CDC, Cancers caused by HPV
truthSource.oneLine: HPV causes about 70% of oropharyngeal (throat and mouth) cancers in the U.S.
